name: dumbbell bear plank alternating row
description: A row from a bear plank position that builds back strength while the core fights to stop hip rotation.
instructions: Start on all fours with a dumbbell in each hand and knees hovering just off the floor.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it back to the floor with control.
Row with the other arm and keep alternating at a steady pace.
